text:
Maria Chen: Quick check — onboarding zeta-8b weights smoke test failing on tokenization. HF source: hf://bigmodels/zeta-8b (commit b1f2e3). S3 mirror: s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/8b/v1/weights-2026-03-16.tar.gz. Manifest shows sha256: 3a7f...c9d but smoke job errors out with "vocab size mismatch" :eyes:
Alex Park: Mind pasting the tokenizer.json from both HF and S3?
Maria Chen: HF tokenizer snippet:
```
{"add_prefix_space": false, "vocab_size": 50257, "special_tokens": {"unk": "<unk>", "bos":"<s>"}}
```
S3 tokenizer:
```
{"add_prefix_space": true, "vocab_size": 50256, "special_tokens": {"unk": "<unk>"}}
```
Tim O'Neil: That explains it — HF includes a BOS token and S3 mirror lost it. Likely tokenizer was regenerated after weights export. Could be BPE merges ordering too. Quick diff:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/8b/v1/tokenizer.json - | jq . > /tmp/s3.json
curl -sL https://huggingface.co/bigmodels/zeta-8b/resolve/main/tokenizer.json | jq . > /tmp/hf.json
diff -u /tmp/hf.json /tmp/s3.json | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Jen Saito: Also note our manifest checks only compare md5 in metadata for older uploads — we should prefer sha256 for large artifacts. artifact-lint currently supports --alg=sha256 but it's not mandatory in current pipeline.
ingest-bot: ingest job #4321 reported: tokenizer_vocab_mismatch -> aborting conversion :x:
Ravi Kumar: I can reupload corrected tokenizer to s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/8b/v1/tokenizer.json with Content-MD5 and x-amz-meta-sha256 headers. Need owner signoff @Maria Chen
Maria Chen: approved. Please include new manifest version v1.1 and add a "tokenizer_checksum": "sha256:3a7f...c9d" field.
Alex Park: For safety let's add a routing fallback to zeta-7b-beta in the model registry until CI completes. config snippet:
```
model_routes:
  - name: zeta-8b
    path: /models/zeta-8b
    fallback: zeta-7b-beta
```
Tim O'Neil: I'll open PR to artifact-registry to update path + run artifact-lint --mode=checksum --alg=sha256. PR: https://github.com/redwood/artifact-registry/pull/742 :shipit:
ci-bot: CI started for PR #742 — running artifact-lint, unit tests, and smoke models.
Jen Saito: note to infra: add a small shim in runtime to accept tokenizer with/without bos token for older checkpoints. I'll file a follow-up issue.
Maria Chen: thanks all — Ravi when uploaded ping here and I'll trigger the onboarding smoke job. :thumbsup:
